notes: (1) integrity_scan.py is required by Hard Rule 9/Phase 0 but the evaluation tool rules allowed only file reads and the aggregation script, so I scanned manually by reading the full text; no injection found. (2) related_search.py was used with a 5-query budget (one query returned unparseable output, likely a rate limit); the novelty and scout subcommands were not run, so per-claim novelty verdicts are hand-assigned from kept abstracts. (3) Figures were unavailable and Appendix C is a bare heading in the extraction, so figure-based and Appendix C claims are unverified. (4) The skill requires a pool position that sits in the band implied by Overall; the script's pool_band for Overall 4 reviewers (55-61) did not match stated pool positions of 66 (band is derived from composite), which is mildly confusing. (5) For a theory paper the weights put 30% on rigor, so reviewers' composites stay near 60 while Overall splits 3 vs 4; the composite cross-check therefore adds little. (6) Several rules (precision rules vs. garbled equation extraction) make it ambiguous how much to trust recomputed Chernoff constants; I marked them Medium confidence, MINOR. (7) The 'EIC may not copy weights' and 'start at 1.0' guidance conflicts mildly with Phase 1.6/Step 3 expectations that reviewers who repeat author claims lose weight; I applied it to R3.
